subject.title: Feishu channel dispatch completes with replies=0 even though assistant final text is written to session transcript

question: Should Feishu recover current-turn assistant final text from the transcript when replyResult is empty, or should this be solved earlier in the shared reply assembly and durable final-delivery contract?
rationale: The reporter's workaround proves a useful recovery direction, but deciding whether transcript text may become channel-visible after source-delivery suppression is a privacy, duplication, and product-contract decision.

options.title: Fix upstream final assembly
options.body: Recommended: capture a live Feishu repro and repair the shared or Feishu reply boundary so the final payload remains deliverable without broad steady-state transcript scraping.

options.title: Authorize bounded transcript recovery
options.body: Allow Feishu to recover only a timestamp-checked current-turn transcript final while preserving message_tool_only, intentional silence, and send-policy denial boundaries.

options.title: Defer to cross-channel contract
options.body: Keep this as concrete Feishu evidence while the broader durable final-delivery semantics are settled in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

recommendation.title: Fix upstream final assembly
recommendation.body: Recommended: capture a live Feishu repro and repair the shared or Feishu reply boundary so the final payload remains deliverable without broad steady-state transcript scraping.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-channel reply-delivery policy choice, and the history shows adjacent Feishu fallback and shared reply-dispatch work by this owner candidate.
